enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Quality Spell Resistance +5: +5 Quality bonus to Spell Resistance.
Resistance +7: Passive: +7 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

Quality Proof Against Poison +1: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +1 Quality bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 2 + their Fortitude save).
Quality Spell Save +1: This item gives a +1 Quality bonus to your saves versus spells.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
